articles.summary: A New Chapter in Our International Growth Journey: Ho Chi Minh City angela.wan+a Thu, 08/27/2026 - 13:28 Cathay Bank proudly celebrated the grand opening of its Vietnam Representative Office on August 21, marking an important milestone in the Bank's continued expansion across the Asia-Pacific region. Located in the Royal Center Building in Ho Chi Minh City, the new office reinforces Cathay Bank's long-term commitment to supporting clients, building relationships, and strengthening connections in one of Southeast Asia's most dynamic markets. “We are pleased to expand our presence in Vietnam with the establishment of this Representative Office,” said Mr. Dunson K. Cheng , Executive Chairman of the Board of Cathay General Bancorp and Cathay Bank. “This opening marks an important step in the Bank's ongoing international growth and demonstrates its long-term commitment to building meaningful relationships and serving communities across the Asia-Pacific region.” Senior leadership and invited guests came together for the ribbon-cutting ceremony to commemorate the grand opening of Cathay Bank’s Representative Office in Vietnam. The grand opening was attended by senior leadership and community members to celebrate the occasion. Attendees included Executive Chairman Dunson K. Cheng , EVP, Special Advisor, Allen Y.L. Peng , SVP, Team Manager, Alex J. Zheng , SVP, Portfolio Manager, An Pham Jr. , and Hoai Anh Nguyen , Chief Representative of the Vietnam Office. The event highlighted the collaborative effort behind the successful establishment of the office and underscored Cathay Bank's vision of creating opportunities and deepening connections throughout the region. The opening expands Cathay Bank's international footprint, bringing the Bank's network to four representative offices across Asia, including Beijing, Shanghai, Taipei, and now Ho Chi Minh City. This addition complements more than 60 branches throughout the United States and the Bank's Hong Kong branch. articles.summary: A Homecoming to Alhambra: Cathay Bank Returns to 601 North Atlantic Boulevard angela.wan+a Fri, 08/21/2026 - 15:58 Cathay Bank is proud to announce the return of its Alhambra Branch to 601 North Atlantic Boulevard, a location that represents an important part of the Bank's history and longstanding connection to the community. Originally designed and built by Cathay Bank in 1985, the branch was created to reflect both the Bank's heritage and its commitment to serving the growing San Gabriel Valley community. Over the years, the building has become a recognizable local landmark, known for its distinctive, green-tiled roof and Asian-inspired architectural design. More than just a branch location, 601 North Atlantic Boulevard stands as a reflection of the cultural roots, entrepreneurial spirit, and community-focused values that have guided Cathay Bank since its founding. Its unique design continues to symbolize the Bank's commitment to honoring its heritage while evolving to meet the needs of future generations. “We are proud to return to a location that represents an important chapter in Cathay Bank's history,” said Chang M. Liu , President and Chief Executive Officer of Cathay Bank. “This relocation reflects our continued commitment to serving our clients and communities while honoring the legacy that has contributed to the Bank's growth. We look forward to welcoming clients to this historic branch and continuing to provide the personalized service and trusted financial solutions they have come to expect from Cathay Bank.” The grand opening ceremony was attended by senior leadership and community members who gathered to commemorate this significant occasion for Cathay Bank. Cathay Bank looks forward to welcoming both longtime clients and new generations of customers to the Alhambra Branch. As the Bank returns to this iconic location, it remains dedicated to building lasting relationships and supporting the growth and success of the community for years to come.
